images.title: Swapping a pair
images.purpose: Show that swapping a smaller number for a bigger one raises one sum and lowers the other by the same amount, closing the gap.
images.composition: Two groups of three cards with the gap of 4 between the sums 17 and 21, a double arrow between the 2 and the 4, and below them two equal sums of 19.
images.exact_structure: Plain white frame, 1456 by 816. Two groups of three cards with a swap between them, and the new sums below. TOP HALF: LEFT TRAY a rectangle x 100 to 560, y 120 to 330, white fill, dark #2B2B2B outline 3 px, label Group 1 in dark #1F2937 bold sans-serif (44 px) centred at x 330, y 90; inside it 3 cards, each a rounded rectangle 110 by 130 px, y 160 to 290, filled teal #0072B2, outlined dark 3 px, holding in dark #1F2937 bold sans-serif (80 px) the digits 2 (x 120 to 230), 6 (x 260 to 370) and 9 (x 400 to 510). RIGHT TRAY a rectangle x 896 to 1356, y 120 to 330, the same style, label Group 2 centred at x 1126, y 90; inside it 3 cards filled amber #E69F00 holding 4 (x 916 to 1026), 7 (x 1056 to 1166) and 10 (x 1196 to 1306). A thick double-headed curved arrow in reddish purple #CC79A7 (6 px) arches over from the top of the card 2 (x 175, y 160) to the top of the card 4 (x 971, y 160), peaking at y 60, with the word swap in dark #1F2937 bold sans-serif (48 px) centred at x 573, y 50. Under the left tray at x 330, y 375, the text Sum 17 in dark #1F2937 bold sans-serif (56 px), and under the right tray at x 1126, y 375, the text Sum 21. BETWEEN THE SUMS: a thin double-headed arrow in construction grey #6B7280 (4 px) runs from x 460 to x 996 at y 375, with a break in the middle for the label gap 4 in dark #1F2937 bold sans-serif (48 px) centred at x 728, y 375 on a white patch. MIDDLE: one thick dark arrow (6 px) pointing down at x 728 from y 420 to y 500. BOTTOM HALF: two rounded badges outlined green #009E73 (5 px), the left x 300 to 640, y 540 to 660, the right x 816 to 1156, y 540 to 660, with the text Sum 19 in dark #1F2937 bold sans-serif (64 px) in each, and between them at x 728, y 600 the equals sign in dark #1F2937 bold sans-serif (96 px). No other text. Nothing else in the frame.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
a swap arrow between any cards other than 2 and 4
a gap number other than 4, or a gap shown under the new sums
images.takeaway: Swapping the 2 and the 4 closes the gap of 4: both sums become 19.
images.description: Groups 2, 6, 9 and 4, 7, 10 with the sums 17 and 21 and the gap 4, a swap arrow between 2 and 4, and the new sums 19 and 19.
images.context: Concept image for Swapping a Pair Changes Both Sums, using the example's own numbers (practice values).
images.teaching_notes: Point at the gap of 4 first, then at the two swapped cards and the two new sums. The slip to watch: thinking only the sum that receives the bigger card changes.

image_decisions.why: The concept is how one swap changes both sums at once; the before and after sums in one picture make that visible.
